scope: Seat, fixed switch body and its two embedded terminals are installed together into the open upper shell before connecting their two wires. Cap remains at its upper retention stop. The actuator follows its body until the actual striker face is reached, then compresses relative to that body.
method: Full evaluated source triangles; discrete BVH overlaps and bounded bidirectional interior witnesses. Actuator contacts additionally reconstruct every returned triangle intersection and require the actual striker endpoint plane and zero interior penetration.

reverseRemoval.method: Reverse exactly the recorded poses with the wires disconnected and the lower shell open; no closed-housing service access or friction/force reversibility is inferred.

slidingClearance.limitation: These revalidated vertex/triangle-centroid nearest distances are upper bounds on the global minimum; not a positive-clearance or manufacturing-tolerance certificate.

limitations: The separate seat/upper lock audit is still required for bearing support and anti-pull retention.
No continuous collision detection, switch force curve, wire flexibility, assembly force, spring stress or manufacturing certification is inferred.
Terminal to plastic boundaries are fixed embedded interfaces in the same rigid subgroup; the final assembly audit separately verifies those local contacts and solder regions.
